scope: pin-first synthetic local-Git first-host code bootstrap and storage-binding rehearsal

source.remote: ephemeral local bare Git fixture containing the exact source commit
source.pre_instruction_card_hash_check: passed against the rehearsal's source-recorded pin independent of Kingston; distribution of a persistent external handoff was not tested

kingston.preflight: diskutil UUID, mount point, APFS type/personality and existing root marker checks passed read-only

positive_result.host_binding: created only under temporary HOME using bind-existing; subsequent check verified Kingston root and 50-GiB floor

negative_results.wrong_commit: blocked at exact-commit fetch; no environment created
negative_results.missing_git_authentication: private GitHub clone failed in a clean HOME with prompting disabled; no checkout accepted

limitations: The successful source was an ephemeral local bare remote, not a clean-host authenticated GitHub fetch.
The clean HOME and fixture are on the existing Mac; this does not qualify a physically separate host.
A persistent external handoff carrying the commit and card-hash pins was not distributed or tested.
The Kingston binding rehearsal created only temporary host config; it restored no Brain data, owner runtime, protected custody, or Kingston corpus.
The rehearsal reports code bootstrap only and does not alter the factory-reset NO-GO verdict.
